name: cc-status-dot-companion
description: Detects Claude Code extension auto-updates and silently re-applies the cc-status-dot patch. Ships inside the vscode-claude-code-status-dot npm package — install via: npx vscode-claude-code-status-dot

ccStatusDot.notify.description: Show a notification when Claude Code completes a turn (state transitions to done or interrupted).

ccStatusDot.notifyWhenFocused.description: Also fire the completion notification when VSCode is the currently focused window. Disable to only notify when you're in another app.

ccStatusDot.notifySound.description: macOS system sound to play on completion notification (ignored on Linux/Windows).

ccStatusDot.tokenStatsWindow.description: Time window for the right-side token stats status bar item. 'all' = cumulative (never resets, default); the rolling windows (5min..30d) naturally age out old turns. Match this default with the IIFE cfg.get fallback (pin enforced by test-version-sync.mjs).

ccStatusDot.tokenDisplayMode.description: What to show on the token stats SBI: token count only, USD cost only, or both.

ccStatusDot.tokenSbiVisible.description: Show the token stats status bar item on the right side.

ccStatusDot.tokenLiveDeltaEnabled.description: Read the active session's transcript tail every tick so token counts update during streaming (between hook fires). Disable on perf-sensitive machines.

ccStatusDot.showCost.description: Show the USD cost estimate alongside the token count (requires a matching model entry in token-rates.json — unknown models like GLM are auto-hidden).

ccStatusDot.warnThresholdUsd.description: Notify when the session cost estimate crosses this USD threshold (0 = disabled). Fires once per crossing.

ccStatusDot.rateDisplayMode.description: How to render the live tok/s suffix on the token status bar item: 'off' hides it (for crowded bars / perf-sensitive machines), 'numeric' shows only '1.2k/s', 'sparkline' shows only '▂▄▆█', 'both' (default) shows both.

author: wangdong
